mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN star >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS goodCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN star >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0) AS goodRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(star), 1), 0) AS averageStar, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN star = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star1Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN star = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star2Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN star = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star3Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN star = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star4Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN star = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star5Count FROM pms_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND show_status = 1

SELECT c.id, c.product_id, c.member_id, c.member_nick_name, c.product_name, c.star, c.create_time, c.show_status, c.product_attribute, c.content, c.pics, c.member_icon, c.collect_couont, c.replay_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pms_comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id AND l.member_id = #{memberId}) AS liked FROM pms_comment c WHERE c.product_id = #{productId} AND c.show_status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.product_id, c.product_name, COALESCE(i.product_pic, p.pic) AS product_pic, c.star, c.content, c.pics, c.create_time, c.show_status, c.replay_count, c.collect_couont FROM pms_comment c LEFT JOIN oms_order_item i ON i.id = c.order_item_id LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.show_status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS reply_id, c.id AS comment_id, c.product_id, c.product_name, COALESCE(i.product_pic, p.pic) AS product_pic, c.content AS comment_content, r.member_nick_name AS reply_member_nick_name, r.member_icon AS reply_member_icon, r.content AS reply_content, r.create_time AS reply_create_time FROM pms_comment c JOIN pms_comment_replay r ON r.comment_id = c.id LEFT JOIN oms_order_item i ON i.id = c.order_item_id LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.show_status = 1 AND (r.member_id IS NULL OR r.member_id <> #{memberId}) ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT o.id AS orderId, i.id AS orderItemId FROM oms_order o JOIN oms_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN pms_comment c ON c.order_item_id = i.id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.status = 3 AND o.delete_status = 0 AND i.product_id = #{productId} AND c.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT 1
